title: review: B9 fix round 1: answer security review T-1577: tests for every re-gate guard condition, synthetic_commit read from the result, merge_gate recorded on every gate run
spec:
Goal T-1403, wave 2, plan label B9-fix1. Fix round of T-1552 (constraints.fix_round_for = T-1552): T-1552 (a59e2a3 on task/T-1552, cut from goal/T-1403 at 9f59c6d) passed the gate; security review T-1577 returned request_changes with one med and two lows, all in scope. Work on the task branch cut from task/T-1552 (spawn.base_for cuts fix rounds from the fix_round_for branch). The T-1552 spec is the behaviour contract; this round changes tests plus the two small merge.py points below. Locate every insertion point by symbol, never by line number.

M1 (tests/test_merge.py, test_merge_reuses_daemon_gate_when_target_unmoved): the test covers only the reuse case. Extend it (table-driven subtests are fine, same test id) so that with gate.run_gate patched and counted it asserts run_gate IS called and the result records pipeline.merge_gate mode 'ran' in each of: the target head differs from pipeline.gated_target_sha (target moved); pipeline.gated_head differs from HEAD after the rebase; pipeline.gated_at absent; the result marked synthetic_commit (see L1); [merge].skip_regate_when_unmoved False in the config passed to merge; and the reuse case still does not call run_gate, returns gate 'reused_green' and records mode 'reused_green'. Each guard must be removable only by failing a subtest.
L1 (orchestrator/merge.py, the can_reuse expression): no producer of a synthetic_commit marker exists yet (B4c is parked); pin where it lives: the marker is truthy result.synthetic_commit on the task's result dict (t.get('result') or {}).get('synthetic_commit'), in addition to the existing t.get('synthetic_commit') and pipeline.get('synthetic_commit') reads; state this in a one-line comment at the expression. The M1 synthetic subtest sets result.synthetic_commit = True and asserts run_gate is called.
L2 (orchestrator/merge.py): pipeline.merge_gate = {'mode': 'ran', ...} is recorded whenever run_gate actually runs, including when the gate ends red (tests_red hold) or gate_timeout (held), written in the same bus.update that writes that hold; reuse writes {'mode': 'reused_green', 'gated_target_sha', 'gated_head'} as today. Add one subtest in the same test: run_gate patched to return a red result -> the task is held/failed exactly as today AND pipeline.merge_gate mode is 'ran'.

Keep tests/test_daemon.py::test_gate_records_target_sha_and_head_on_green passing unchanged. Run tests/test_merge.py and tests/test_daemon.py in the foreground after committing; never background a command and never run the full gate; the daemon runs .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh. Write tests as unittest.TestCase methods using tests/_harness.py like the neighbouring tests.

Out of scope: daemon.py behaviour beyond what T-1552 already changed, gate.py, spawn.py. Rollback: git revert of the merge commit of this round.
acceptance: tests/test_daemon.py::test_gate_records_target_sha_and_head_on_green: passes unchanged: after a green daemon gate the task's pipeline holds gated_at, gated_target_sha equal to the goal branch head and gated_head equal to the worktree HEAD; a red gate writes neither

tests/test_merge.py::test_merge_reuses_daemon_gate_when_target_unmoved: passes: with gate.run_gate patched, merge.merge on a task whose pipeline.gated_target_sha equals the target head and whose rebase is a no-op does not call run_gate, merges, returns gate 'reused_green' and records pipeline.merge_gate mode 'reused_green'; and run_gate IS called with merge_gate mode 'ran' recorded, each as its own subtest, when the target moved, when gated_head differs from HEAD after the rebase, when gated_at is absent, when result.synthetic_commit is truthy, and when [merge].skip_regate_when_unmoved is False; a red run_gate result holds the task as today and still records merge_gate mode 'ran'

result.summary: I could not find the fix-round diff. The reviewed worktree is task/T-1579 at HEAD 9f59c6d, which has no commits and no changes against that base. It was not cut from task/T-1552, so it lacks the T-1552 work. The only diff I could produce, task/T-1552 to HEAD, just removes the T-1552 implementation and tests. I did not find a task/T-1578 branch here. Judged against the acceptance criteria, none of the required work is present.

comments.issue: test_merge_reuses_daemon_gate_when_target_unmoved is not extended. The required subtests are missing: target moved, gated_head differs after rebase, gated_at absent, result.synthetic_commit truthy, skip_regate_when_unmoved False, and a red run_gate result recording merge_gate 'ran'. Nothing guards the reuse conditions in merge.merge. In this worktree the test and the T-1552 reuse logic do not exist at all.

There is no can_reuse expression here, so the L1 change (reading result.synthetic_commit plus a one-line comment) is absent. The L2 change is also absent: merge_gate mode 'ran' is not recorded when the gate ends red or times out, in the same bus.update as the hold. The gate always runs and no merge_gate is ever recorded.

test_gate_records_target_sha_and_head_on_green does not exist in this tree, and daemon.gate does not write gated_target_sha or gated_head. The acceptance criterion says it passes unchanged. The branch was not cut from task/T-1552 as the spec requires (spawn.base_for), so the work is missing the T-1552 base.
